name: allplay
description: All Play: voice-first accessible games. Root scripts only; each package owns its own dependencies.

scripts.lint: npm run check:docs && npm run check:aws-profile && npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix web-app && npm run lint --prefix cdk
scripts.test: npm run test:coverage --prefix backend && npm run test:coverage --prefix web-app && npm run test:coverage --prefix cdk
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix web-app && npm run build --prefix cdk
scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix backend && npm ci --prefix web-app && npm ci --prefix cdk
